title: MetaSPR Assay Protocol for Binding Interaction Between IL21 and IL21R Proteins
author: Rosie Liu
materials: Analyte (IL-21R) Solutions: Prepare seven concentrations by diluting IL-21R stock into 1X sample diluent: 0 (blank), 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, 20, and 40 µg/mL. For instance, to make 40 µg/mL, dilute 20 µL of 1.0 mg/mL stock into 480 µL diluent. Similarly, prepare each dilution (use serial dilution for accuracy). Prepare at least 50 µL of each for filling wells. Keep all analyte solutions on ice briefly before dispensing.
Additional Buffers: Have an extra 1X sample diluent and water available. Degas all solutions if your SPR instrument requires bubble-free fluids (e.g., by vacuum or sonication).

Binding Curves: Use the MetaSPR software to plot sensorgram curves (Response Units vs time or concentration). For each IL-21R concentration, verify that the response increases with higher analyte concentration. Subtract the blank (0 µg/mL) curve to correct for nonspecific signal.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Bring IL-21 and IL-21R vials to room temperature from –20°C/–80°C storage and briefly centrifuge to collect powder.

steps.title: Reconstitute Proteins
steps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized proteins in sterile water to a high concentration (0.5–1.0 mg/mL). For IL-21 and IL-21R, use a final stock of 0.5 mg/mL by adding sterile water directly to the vial and gently swirling to dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Add glycerol to a final 20–50% (v/v) concentration if storing aliquots at –20°C.

steps.title: Remove Particulates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge each protein solution at 10,000×g for 5 min to pellet insoluble material.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Filter the solution through a 0.22 µm filter if needed.

steps.title: Prepare Working Aliquots
steps.instruction: Dilute and aliquot stocks to minimize freeze-thaw cycles and store at –20°C or –80°C.

substeps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot on ice before the assay and keep on ice to prevent degradation.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and solutions for the assay.

substeps.instruction: 1X Sample Diluent: Dilute 10X sample diluent 1:10 with sterile water; mix well and equilibrate to 25°C.
1X Elution/Regeneration Solution: Dilute 5X regenerant concentrate 1:5 with sterile water.
Protective Solution: Use as supplied by the kit (no dilution).

steps.title: Prepare Ligand Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute IL-21 stock into 1X sample diluent to a final concentration of 10 µg/mL immediately before use (e.g., 10 µL of 0.5 mg/mL stock into 490 µL of 1X diluent).

substeps.instruction: Mix gently by pipetting and keep on ice until use.

steps.title: Instrument and Chip Setup
steps.instruction: Set up the WeSPR™ 200 instrument and biosensor chip.

substeps.instruction: Power on the instrument.
Insert a clean Protein A biosensor chip into a new 96-well plate.
Prime instrument lines with 1X sample diluent, ensuring no air bubbles are trapped.
Equilibrate system temperature to 25°C.
Pipette 100 µL of 1X sample diluent into a well and monitor until the signal stabilizes.
Wipe any spills and equilibrate the chip surface (using protective solution if recommended by the kit).

steps.title: Capture Ligand (IL-21)
steps.instruction: Immobilize hFc-tagged IL-21 onto the Protein A chip surface.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL of 10 µg/mL human IL-21 solution into designated wells using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Gently pat the edge of the chip plate on absorbent paper to remove unbound ligand, avoiding contact with the active chip surface.

steps.title: Analyte Binding (IL-21R)
steps.instruction: Bind IL-21R analyte to the immobilized IL-21.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 50 µL of diluted Human IL21R Protein solutions (0, 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, 20, and 40 µg/mL) into corresponding wells (0 µg/mL serves as blank).
Incubate all wells at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Gently pat the chip plate dry with absorbent paper to remove unbound analyte.

steps.title: Dissociation Phase
steps.instruction: Monitor the dissociation of the IL-21/IL-21R complex.

substeps.instruction: Load 150 µL of 1× Sample Diluent into each chip well.
Incubate at room temperature for exactly 20 minutes while the system records real-time RU changes.

steps.title: Chip Regeneration
steps.instruction: Strip bound proteins from the Protein A chip surface.

substeps.instruction: Load 150 µL of 1× Elution Regenerant into each chip well.
Incubate for the time specified in the kit instructions (typically 30–60 seconds).
Gently pat the chip plate dry with absorbent paper.

steps.title: Post-Regeneration Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the chip wells to remove residual regenerant.

substeps.instruction: Wash twice with 150 µL of 1× Sample Diluent per well, patting dry after each wash.
Wash twice with 150 µL of sterile deionized water per well, patting dry after each wash.

steps.title: Chip Storage
steps.instruction: Store the chip if not analyzed immediately.

substeps.instruction: Load 150 µL of Protective Solution (G21003) into each chip well.
Seal the chip plate tightly with sealing film and store at 4°C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Kinetic Fitting
steps.instruction: Analyze the association and dissociation phases using a 1:1 binding model to extract kinetic parameters.

substeps.instruction: Calculate association rate (Ka), dissociation rate (Kd), and equilibrium dissociation constant (KD = Kd/Ka).
